title: Beforest - Forest Investment Reimagined
description: Pitch deck for Beforest, a forest investment company that makes sustainable forestry accessible to everyone.

slides.title: Welcome to Beforest
slides.content:
Welcome to Beforest - where we're reimagining forest investment for the modern investor.

Our mission: Make sustainable forestry accessible to everyone.

We believe forests are more than just trees - they're the future of sustainable investing.

[Company logo and tagline: 'Invest in the Future, Grow with Nature']
slides.notes: Start with energy. Welcome everyone. Emphasize the accessibility angle. Pause after tagline.

slides.title: The Problem
slides.content:
Traditional forestry investment is:

❌ Reserved for ultra-high-net-worth individuals
❌ Opaque and inaccessible
❌ Lacks transparency and reporting
❌ Requires massive capital (>$1M minimum)
❌ Long lock-in periods (10-30 years)

Result: Only 0.1% of investors can access this asset class.

Meanwhile, forests need urgent protection and sustainable management.
slides.notes: Use hand gestures to emphasize each pain point. Make eye contact. This problem resonates emotionally - speak to that.

slides.title: Our Solution
slides.content:
Beforest democratizes forest investment through:

✅ Fractional ownership (starting at $500)
✅ Transparent blockchain-based tracking
✅ Quarterly sustainability reports
✅ Professional forest management
✅ Community-driven investment decisions

Technology meets tradition:
- IoT sensors for real-time monitoring
- AI-powered growth prediction
- Satellite imagery analysis
- Sustainable harvesting protocols

Why invest in forests now?

📈 Growing demand for carbon credits

Your investment grows literally and figuratively.
